answer: Like a coral island crystallizing against shifting tides, decentralized consensus anchors identity in recursive peer staking. An attacker cannot simply sweep in like wind reshaping a loose dune of fake personas. Trust behaves like a indelible pigment bound to a metabolic bond graph, requiring transitive attestations from established nodes. Attempting to fabricate synthetic weight incurs superlinear attacker cost via polynomial slashing penalties, starving identity counterfeits.
